method: Dated primary-source documentary review; alternative fit is editorial inference, without hands-on PSD, RAW or print testing.

route.name: Photoshop Alternatives Without a Subscription
route.description: Desktop raster layers, painting and basic image adjustment without a required software subscription. Compare free official GIMP and Krita desktop releases and Paint.NET Classic; optional paid store distributions have separate terms. PSD exchange, camera RAW processing, print workflows and complete Photoshop feature parity are not guaranteed.

products.editorialNote: Desktop raster layers, painting and basic image adjustment only. GIMP is reviewed for retouching and layered composition; RAW processing uses external plug-ins and native CMYK editing is outside the reviewed scope. No guarantee of full Photoshop, PSD, print-production, automation, AI or team-workflow parity.

Desktop raster layers, painting and basic image adjustment only. Krita is reviewed primarily for illustration and digital painting, not comprehensive photographic retouching. PSD and text/layer semantics need review. No guarantee of full Photoshop, print-production, automation, AI or team-workflow parity.

Desktop raster layers, painting and basic image adjustment only. Paint.NET is reviewed for Windows layers, selections, drawing and color adjustments. PDN is its native layered format; plugin formats do not prove PSD compatibility. No guarantee of full Photoshop, print-production, RAW, automation, AI or team-workflow parity.
